system.description:
This spell creates one or more glowing orbs that appear in the air around the caster and launch themselves at a single target that is visible to the caster (if the caster is firing more than one missile then they may be aimed at different targets) and automatically hit for 1d6+1 damage each, with no save allowed.

For each 5 levels the caster has above 1st two more missiles are created (i.e., 3 missiles at 6th level, 5 missiles at 11th level, 7 missiles at 16th level, 9 missiles at 21st level, 11 missiles at 26th level, 13 missiles at 31st level, 15 missiles at 36th level).
